Hi Alice —

Thanks for the clear requirements. Below is a concise, auditable deletion and evidence workflow tailored for Private VPC deployments where MedSys manages storage and KMS: 

Summary (high level):
- Data residency: Customer data (payloads, embeddings, model-generated artifacts, and associated metadata) remains stored in customer-managed buckets or in resources provisioned inside your VPC. Redwood components that run in your VPC do not retain a second copy outside the agreed storage tier.

- KMS & keys: You may bring-your-own-keys (BYOK) via your cloud provider KMS. Redwood will not have access to plaintext if keys are customer-managed. We can document key rotation and any necessary escrow only if explicitly requested in the contract.

Deletion flow (assisted wipe):
1) Deprovision compute and revoke runtime access (0–2 hours) — we terminate inference nodes and revoke service principals used by Redwood.
2) Object-level delete in customer storage (0–48 hours) — if Redwood has been writing to buckets under your account, we execute the deletion job that removes objects and manifests.
3) Metadata purge & index update (0–7 days) — metadata, indexes, and search artifacts are removed from our runtime indices and any cached KV entries are zeroed.
4) Backup and snapshot handling (policy dependent) — by default snapshots/backups are retained for up to 90 days in your account unless the SOW opts for expedited purge; we offer an accelerated backup purge for an additional compliance fee with a target of 30 days.
5) Cryptographic key destruction (optional) — if you want cryptographic evidence, you can request that the KMS keys used be rotated/destroyed under your control; Redwood can provide a statement that we no longer have access to ciphertext keys.

Evidence package we provide after completion:
- Deletion execution log (signed) with timestamps
- Object manifest showing deleted keys
- Runtime access revocation audit (service principal tokens)
- Snapshot purge log (if accelerated purge requested)
- OPTIONAL: Signed attestation (PDF) and hash chaining evidence for forensic verification

Timelines & SLAs:
- Standard package: full deletion evidence bundle provided within 10 business days of request (object deletion + metadata purge; snapshots retained up to 90 days).
- Accelerated package: full evidence provided within 3 business days (accelerated snapshot purge to target 30 days), requires SOW addendum.

Suggested contract clause (summary form):
- "Upon Customer's written termination request, Redwood will execute a complete data removal process for Customer Data stored in Customer-managed VPC resources and provide a signed evidence package within 10 business days. If Customer elects accelerated snapshot purge, Redwood will target a 30-day purge period and provide supporting logs and a signed attestation upon completion."

I attached a short operational playbook that maps our scripts to the above steps and sample log outputs. If you want formal Wipe Certification language, we can provide a redline for your legal team.

Happy to join a call Wednesday to walk the team through the logs if that helps.

— Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel, Compliance — Redwood Inference
